review_candidates.description: atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark. With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure. Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden. We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact. By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure. Engineering Subject Matter Expert – CSA at atNorth Are you a seasoned engineering expert with a passion for delivering world-class data centre infrastructure? At atNorth, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of sustainable, high-performance data centres across the Nordics. As the technical authority for Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) engineering, you will influence major business-critical projects from concept through commissioning, ensuring technical excellence, engineering integrity, and operational reliability at every stage. This is a unique opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with strategic influence, working closely with clients, project teams, consultants, and industry-leading specialists to drive innovation in one of Europe's fastest-growing sectors. Key Responsibilities Act as the technical authority and signatory for CSA engineering designs, calculations, specifications, and project deliverables. Provide expert leadership across the full Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) scope throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure alignment and integration across all CSA disciplines, driving consistency, quality, and engineering excellence in project delivery. Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing (MEP), Design Managers, consultants, contractors, and project teams to ensure successful multidisciplinary coordination and integration. Develop and maintain CSA engineering standards, design guides, technical specifications, and best-practice frameworks across atNorth's data centre portfolio. Review and approve engineering solutions, technical deviations, material selections, and design changes within delegated authority. Support project delivery teams through design, construction, commissioning, and operational handover. Serve as the primary CSA technical advisor to hyperscale, enterprise, and colocation clients, translating business requirements into robust engineering solutions. Evaluate emerging technologies, construction methods, and industry developments relevant to CSA design and delivery. Provide technical mentoring and coaching to Design Managers and engineering teams, strengthening internal capability and knowledge sharing. Contribute to long-term asset strategy, operational resilience, lifecycle planning, and continuous improvement initiatives across atNorth's infrastructure portfolio. Your profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 10 years of experience in CSA engineering and the delivery of complex infrastructure, mission-critical, or data centre projects, including progression into senior technical leadership roles. Strong expertise in Civil, Structural, or Architectural engineering, with the ability and credibility to provide technical leadership and oversight across the entire CSA discipline. Extensive experience delivering data centre engineering projects and a solid understanding of how CSA disciplines interface with Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing (MEP) systems within critical infrastructure environments. Deep understanding of data centre design, constructability, commissioning processes, and operational resilience principles. Strong knowledge of industry standards and best practices, including TIA-942, EN 50600, and other relevant engineering frameworks. Proven experience acting as a technical authority, reviewing and approving complex engineering designs and technical documentation. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present technical concepts effectively to both engineering and executive audiences. A collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset, combined with the confidence to challenge, influence, and drive high engineering standards across multiple projects and regions. Fluent English and willingness to travel across the Nordic region as required. About The AtNorth Culture We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate. We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced. We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation. At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

review_candidates.title: Technical Project Manager (PM)
review_candidates.description: Job Description Work Model: 4 days in office – compulsory. 3 days in office (shift: 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM) and remaining 2 days from home (shift: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM). Experience: 5+ years Domain: Technology Delivery | Software Project Management | Agile Program Management Context66 is a Data, AI, and Enterprise Architecture services company focused on engineering the context that powers AI. We help enterprises transform fragmented data, systems, documents, and business knowledge into trusted, governed, reusable, and AI-ready enterprise context. Our work spans modern data foundations, enterprise data architecture, integration, semantic layers, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, ontologies, metadata, intelligent automation, and production-grade AI systems. We believe AI does not scale on data alone. It scales on trusted context. Role Overview - Context66 is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to support a strategic client engagement. - The ideal candidate combines project management discipline with a strong technical background in software delivery, Agile/Scrum execution, and cross-functional stakeholder management. - Own end-to-end delivery of technical projects — scope, timelines, budgets, and quality — across engineering, QA, and product teams. - Prior experience managing technical delivery in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment is a strong advantage. Key Responsibilities Project Planning & Delivery - Own end-to-end delivery of technical projects — scope, timelines, budgets, and quality. - Translate business requirements into clear, actionable technical project plans in collaboration with engineering and product teams. - Manage project timelines proactively, tracking milestones, dependencies, and delivery risk to avoid slippage. - Maintain a centralized repository of project plans, decisions, and documentation with clear audit trails. Agile Delivery Management - Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives) across engineering teams. - Manage sprint backlogs and release planning, ensuring alignment between product priorities and engineering capacity. - Conduct regular delivery reviews to identify blockers, scope creep, and optimization opportunities. - Drive process improvement initiatives, including tooling upgrades, workflow standardization, and elimination of delivery bottlenecks. Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination - Coordinate resource allocation and manage delivery across multiple teams and, where applicable, external vendors. - Act as the primary point of contact between engineering teams, stakeholders, and leadership. - Lead vendor/partner coordination where third-party teams are involved, holding them accountable to timelines and quality commitments. - Serve as the primary point of escalation for delivery risks and cross-team blockers. Governance & Reporting - Lead risk and issue resolution efforts, including scope disputes, resourcing conflicts, and delivery escalations. - Establish governance frameworks, reporting cadences, and escalation paths for project and team performance. - Partner with engineering, QA, product, and leadership to ensure adherence to development best practices and release processes. - Provide executive-level reporting on project status, delivery metrics, risk exposure, and team performance. Understanding Of - Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) & Release Management. - Agile / Scrum & Sprint Planning. - Requirements Gathering & Technical Documentation. - Resource & Capacity Planning. - Risk & Dependency Management. - Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination. - Reporting, Governance & Compliance. Required Experience and Skills - 5+ years in Technical Project Management, Program Management, or Agile Delivery Management roles. - Proven experience managing full project lifecycles, including planning, execution, and delivery. - Strong background in Agile/Scrum methodologies and sprint-based delivery. - Hands-on experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or similar). - Demonstrated success in stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination. - Track record of driving on-time, high-quality delivery across engineering teams. - Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. - Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, QA, product, and leadership teams. Preferred / Good to Have - PMP, CSM, or SAFe certification. - Experience working with enterprise-scale, multi-team engineering environments. - Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines. - Prior experience supporting large-scale or client-facing technical engagements. - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
